Remaining DeviceUseStatement mentions are historical or compatibility references such as release history, fhir-old-types, resource-name-tracker, and the fhir.ini cross-version alias DeviceUseStatement=@DeviceUsage.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core build does not need a source edit: implementer-facing core text uses DeviceUsage or links to the external OO incubator artifact, and the old name remains only where preserving history or conversion compatibility is appropriate.
